title: floodPodline mints 0.1% of Bean supply to the Field every Flood season, harvestable in pod (FIFO) order — front-runnable by buying the front of the pod line before an Oversaturation streak
description: LibFlood.floodPodline() makes up to FLOOD_PODLINE_PERCENT_DENOMINATOR^-1 = 0.1% of total Bean supply worth of Pods Harvestable on every flood season (it runs first in the flood branch, before the well SOP). Harvestable Pods are consumed strictly in pod-line (FIFO) index order. Because a Flood is permissionlessly triggerable via sunrise/gm() once Beanstalk has been Oversaturated for a season, and because the marketplace lets Pods near the front of the line be purchased, a well-capitalized actor who anticipates an Oversaturation streak can accumulate the front-most Pods (or sow into the front) cheaply and then permissionlessly drive the flood seasons to ripen 0.1% of supply per season directly into those positions. The reward is bounded (0.1% of supply per season, capped by maxHarvestable) and the front-of-line Pods are a public, priced market, so this is opportunistic value capture / reward-timing rather than theft of others' principal — hence Medium, not High.
impact: An actor timing the controllable Flood schedule can convert held Beans into a near-deterministic stream of Field harvest at the front of the pod line, advantaging informed/MEV-capable participants over passive Pod holders. Bounded to 0.1% of supply per flood season and to the front of the line; no protocol insolvency, but a recurring incentive-timing edge.

ite.intent: Capture the per-flood 0.1%-of-supply Field mint by controlling the front of the pod line and the (permissionless) flood timing
ite.technique: Acquire front-of-line Pods, then permissionlessly trigger successive flood seasons via sunrise/gm() so floodPodline() ripens supply into those positions FIFO
ite.evasion: Flood ripening is intended protocol behavior; the edge is informational/timing, leaving no invariant violated
